\section{Overview}

Declarations of the Lean module \texttt{FABL.Chapter06.F₂Polynomials.NumericalNormalForm}.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{definition}[Real-valued function on the binary cube]
\lean{FABL.PseudoBooleanFunction}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p036-b001,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p149-b001,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p164-b007
}
\label{FABL.PseudoBooleanFunction}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.F₂Cube}
A pseudo-Boolean function on $n$ coordinates is a real-valued function on the
$n$-dimensional binary cube.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Numerical coefficients]
\lean{FABL.NumericalCoefficients}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p036-b001,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p164-b007
}
\label{FABL.NumericalCoefficients}
\leanok
A numerical coefficient family on $n$ coordinates is a real-valued function on the set
of subsets of the $n$ coordinates.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Numerical monomial]
\lean{FABL.numericalMonomial}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p036-b001,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p148-b005,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p149-b001,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p169-b008
}
\label{FABL.numericalMonomial}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.F₂Cube}
For a subset $S$ of the $n$ coordinates and a binary vector
$x\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$, define its numerical monomial to be $1$ if every
coordinate in $S$ equals $1$, and $0$ otherwise; equivalently, it is the product over
$i\in S$ of the indicator that $x_i=1$.
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Numerical evaluation]
\lean{FABL.numericalEval}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p036-b001,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p149-b001,
  pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p164-b007
}
\label{FABL.numericalEval}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.NumericalCoefficients, FABL.PseudoBooleanFunction, FABL.numericalMonomial}
Given real coefficients $c(S)$ indexed by subsets $S$ of the $n$ coordinates, define the
associated function on binary vectors by $x\mapsto\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}c(S)m_S(x)$, where
$m_S$ is the numerical monomial that is $1$ exactly when every coordinate in $S$ equals
$1$, and is $0$ otherwise.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Numerical monomial on a subset indicator]
\lean{FABL.numericalMonomial_f₂CubeOfFinset}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.f₂CubeOfFinset, FABL.f₂CubeOfFinset_apply, FABL.numericalMonomial}
\difficulty{4}
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $S$ and $U$ be subsets of its coordinates. The
numerical monomial indexed by $S$, evaluated at the binary vector equal to $1$ precisely
on $U$, is $1$ if $S\\subseteq U$ and $0$ otherwise.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Evaluation on a subset indicator]
\lean{FABL.numericalEval_f₂CubeOfFinset}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.NumericalCoefficients, FABL.f₂CubeOfFinset, FABL.numericalEval, FABL.numericalMonomial, FABL.numericalMonomial_f₂CubeOfFinset}
\difficulty{4}
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $c$ assign a real coefficient to each subset of the $n$
coordinates, and let $U$ be such a subset. Evaluating the associated numerical
polynomial at the binary vector that is $1$ exactly on $U$ gives $\\sum_{S\\subseteq
U}c(S)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Linear numerical evaluation map]
\lean{FABL.numericalEvalLinear}
\label{FABL.numericalEvalLinear}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.NumericalCoefficients, FABL.PseudoBooleanFunction, FABL.numericalEval}
For each natural number $n$, numerical evaluation defines a linear map over $\mathbb{R}$
from real coefficients indexed by subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to real-valued functions
on $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Dimensions of coefficient and function spaces]
\lean{FABL.finrank_numericalCoefficients_eq_pseudoBooleanFunction}
\label{FABL.finrank_numericalCoefficients_eq_pseudoBooleanFunction}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.NumericalCoefficients, FABL.PseudoBooleanFunction, FABL.f₂CubeEquivFinset}
\difficulty{1}
For every nonnegative integer $n$, the real vector space of functions from the subsets
of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb R$ and the real vector space of functions from
$(\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z)^n$ to $\mathbb R$ have equal dimension.
\end{theorem}

For every natural number $n$ and every function $\varphi:(\mathbb{F}_2^n)\to\mathbb{R}$,
there is a unique assignment of a real coefficient $c(S)$ to each subset
$S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ such that, for every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$,
$\varphi(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}c(S)\prod_{i\in S}\mathbf{1}_{\{x_i=1\}}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Alternating sum over an interval of subsets]
\lean{FABL.sum_Icc_neg_one_pow_card_sub}
\label{FABL.sum_Icc_neg_one_pow_card_sub}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $n$ be a natural number and let $T,U\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$ be finite sets with
$T\subseteq U$. The sum of $(-1)^{|S|-|T|}$ over all sets $S$ with $T\subseteq
S\subseteq U$ equals $1$ if $T=U$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Möbius coefficients]
\lean{FABL.numericalMobiusCoeff}
\statementsource{Analysis-of-Boolean-Functions-by-Ryan-ODonnell}{pdf-ffbe9c7b3306-p164-b007}
\label{FABL.numericalMobiusCoeff}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.NumericalCoefficients, FABL.PseudoBooleanFunction, FABL.f₂CubeOfFinset}
For a real-valued function $\varphi$ on binary vectors of length $n$, define its Möbius
coefficient at a coordinate subset $S$ by $\displaystyle\sum_{T\subseteq
S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\varphi(1_T)$, where $1_T$ is the binary vector whose coordinates in $T$
equal $1$ and whose other coordinates equal $0$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Möbius formula for numerical coefficients]
\lean{FABL.numericalCoeff_eq_mobius_sum}
\label{FABL.numericalCoeff_eq_mobius_sum}
\leanok
\uses{FABL.PseudoBooleanFunction, FABL.f₂CubeOfFinset, FABL.numericalCoeff, FABL.numericalMobiusCoeff_eq_numericalCoeff}
\difficulty{1}
For any $n\ge 0$, let $\varphi:(\mathbb{F}_2)^n\to\mathbb{R}$ and let $S$ be a subset of
the coordinate set. Its numerical coefficient at $S$ is $\displaystyle \sum_{T\subseteq
S}(-1)^{|S|-|T|}\varphi(\mathbf{1}_T)$, where $\mathbf{1}_T$ is $1$ on $T$ and $0$
outside $T$.
\end{theorem}
